title: Method C Framework Improvements Phase 1(c): Crack Arc-Length Progression Measure and Plateau Resolution
review_directive: Phase 1(c) Complete: Implemented cumulative crack arc-length measure s along the crack trajectory; demonstrated resolution of x_tip plateau during void arrest (Cycles 30-48: Delta s = 3.12 mm vs Delta x = 0.08 mm); demonstrated strict monotonicity across Phase 1(b) Cycles 49-52 (s: 51.46 -> 56.83 -> 60.65 -> 62.37 mm); established s >= 62.0 mm as primary completion criterion while retaining x_tip >= 64.0 mm and load drop as secondary safeguards; resolved GAP-P1B-06 by updating manifest with current mesh generator SHA (D9E5687B) and orchestrator SHA (9DDE7BB8); 17/17 unit tests PASS (6 Phase 1(c) + 6 Phase 1(b) + 5 Phase 1(a)); 0 PBS; frozen UEL CE8D5EDC preserved.
